title: 3.2.0 dev i Combo Pairing
symptom: In the Native Combo driver, after the pump is found via Bluetooth, the user cannot enter the 10-digit pairing code because there is no enter or send button, and the pump times out. The issue occurs repeatedly.
cause: The input field has a fixed width, which may hide the OK button on certain devices or orientations.
fix: The issue will be fixed by a pull request. As a workaround, put the device in landscape mode to press the OK button after entering the pairing code.
evidence_quote: The input field has a fixed width in the moment, just put your device in landscape mode to press the ok button, after entering the pairing code.
